The '''GDU CGL Droid Carrier''' was a model of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] that was around during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The GDU MG Droid Carrier appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It was added to the game with the release of the "Master the Fight: Cargo Transport Edition" bundle on [[April 21]], [[2026]].<ref name="Bundle">{{Steam|url=app/4029110/STAR_WARS_The_Old_Republic__Master_the_Fight_Cargo_Transport_Edition|text=STAR WARS™: The Old Republic™ - Master the Fight: Cargo Transport Edition}}</ref>
